events.what_it_is: A two-day Sarti Spritz U.S.-launch activation during NYFW with DJ sets, photo moments, branded experiences and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Free admission to the activation, with custom giveaways advertised while supplies last. The event centers on Sarti Spritz cocktails; no specific giveaway is guaranteed to every attendee.
events.caveats: 21+ only with physical government-issued photo ID. Current event guidance says RSVP is encouraged rather than required; entry is available first-come, first-served subject to capacity. Giveaways are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: September 12–13, 3–7 PM at 480 W 13th Street. Use Sarti's official booking page if you want to RSVP, but walk-up entry is currently described as available subject to capacity, so arriving early is still advisable.
